changes: Added SEGA Day (June 3), Famicom Birthday (July 15), Spyro Anniversary (September 9) and Movie Night (first October weekend), with original pixel scenes, frames and matching recommendations.
Kept SEGA Day focused on other SEGA games, with Sonic retaining its own birthday collection. Fixed anniversary priority when a library weekend overlaps.
Replaced navigation emojis with six generated pixel-art icons, enlarged labels and aligned the controls across desktop, tablet and mobile layouts.
Moved Games before Franchises and styled the seasonal horizontal scrollbar to match the plum interface.
Redrew the March and April scenery with fresh spring daylight, and repaired the December frame rails and unwanted colored bands.
Added changelog history with older/newer navigation, including published versions and the current local build.

Added platform-specific Main story and 100% completion estimates from archived community reports for 314 catalog games, with sample counts and source links. Missing reports remain explicitly unavailable.
Placed game-length estimates alongside the score and progress controls, and standardized the franchise navigation button.
Combined backup, sync, appearance and removed games into one tabbed profile panel; removed the separate footer entry.
